meta.note: Historical rural survey. Agricultural-household measures exclude wage-only households; land/livestock tables also include all/non-agricultural rural households where labelled. Source zeros retained; dashes and unresolved parenthesised cells null, with original value attached. All observed cross-tabs retained; no Cartesian expansion or state averaging.
